name: Eclipsing Binary Star
storyline:
You can see it in the distance. It's there, always present. A reminder. Towering in the background of the sparse autumn daylight, and a blinking, mocking beacon in the dark of night. It lies behind an ocean sea of trees, beyond the unused roads, beyond a chainlink fence perimeter. A radio tower. And below it, a nuclear bunker, built when the only thing on everyone's mind was fear.

You lie there, listening to the radio. Waiting for nothing, I suppose. But that will come to change. Through the atmosphere, comes a signal, and a broadcast. One so innocent and benign. But the overcast sky masks something sinister. Beyond the clouds, beyond the static. Something ever present. Something that will chew away at your world.
summary: Eclipsing Binary Star is a linear visual novel told in NVL format. It was created over the course of three weeks for Denpa VN Jam 2026. First visual novel from pathos softworks.
